name: bird_hoot_sleep
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this Hoot reference into one production key frame. Keep exactly the same pale tawny cream round owl, heart-shaped white facial disc, amber eyes, grey-brown speckled wings, tiny star-patterned blue nightcap, NO ear tufts. Preserve the same square canvas, BODY SCALE and torso location, camera, feather texture and warm upper-left lighting. Sleep: both eyes fully closed, head slightly slumped forward, relaxed wings at sides, mouth closed, both feet on standing baseline. No Zzz, no extra symbols. Whole bird safely within canvas, never scale body down to fit wings. Transparent alpha background, single bird, no floor, shadow, border, text or decorations.
